An '''internal comlink''' was a type of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that was installed on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] was equipped with an internal comlink.<ref name="WDNTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050120a|text=We Don't Need That Scum}}</ref>
